metadata.short_desc: Memory enhancement: remembers your chats and recalls them when relevant
metadata.desc: Long-term memory for your bot: saves chats as memories and recalls the relevant ones; plus person / group profiles, relationship score and expression habits; optional proactive messages and a recall log; ships with its own dashboard.

evolve_auto.hint: Generate evolution proposals on a schedule (turn off to apply manually only).

evolve_min_hours.hint: Minimum hours between proposals; skipped when there is no new memory.

evolve_min_memories.hint: How many new memories to accumulate first. Too few makes the persona drift.

evolve_scope.hint: desc_style: description and speaking style only (default). desc_only: description only. all: rewrite the whole persona.

evolve_require_confirm.hint: On: only produce a proposal for you to approve (recommended). Off: write straight into the native persona.

vision_enabled.hint: Also turn images in chat into memory. Off ignores images entirely.

vision_max_images.hint: Upper bound to keep cost down.

profile_auto.hint: Build a person (L0) / group (L1) profile automatically from new material. Generated per persona.

profile_min_memories.hint: How many memories to accumulate first. Too few makes the model guess. Counted per person and per group.

profile_refresh_hours.hint: Refresh cadence; refreshed earlier when new memories arrive.

profile_batch_per_tick.hint: Max profiles built per persona per round (people and groups counted separately) to keep cost down.

master_switch.hint: Turning it off makes StarHeart leave AstrBot's behaviour completely untouched.

gate_enabled.hint: A local formula decides whether the bot should speak up.

gate_shadow.hint: Record scores without blocking. Recommended for a few days first.

gate_threshold.hint: 0-100, higher makes the bot more reserved.

memory_inject_enabled.hint: Inject recalled memories before the LLM request.

memory_inject_top_k.hint: Maximum number of memories injected each turn.

favour_enabled.hint: Track relationship score and tiers from conversations.

favour_settle_mode.hint: tag: the main model reports it on its last line (currently the only implementation).
labels: self-reported on the model's last line

expression_enabled.hint: Extract habits and feed them back to the model every turn.

output_enabled.hint: Collapse blank lines and strip favour markers from replies.

burst_merge_enabled.hint: Merge several quick messages from one person into a single reply (on for private chats, optional for groups).

burst_merge_window.hint: Messages from the same person inside this window are merged.

burst_merge_group.hint: Off keeps group replies strictly one-by-one, unaffected by bursts.

output_typo_mode.hint: off / light / medium: swaps adjacent Chinese characters. Code blocks and links are left alone.

memory_persona_isolated.hint: Each persona only reads and writes its own memories. Switch the viewing scope from the top bar.

forget_enabled.hint: Long-unmentioned memories get archived, then forgotten.

archive_after_days.hint: How long without being mentioned before archiving.

forget_after_days.hint: How long after archiving, without being mentioned and being unimportant, before forgetting.

forget_min_strength.hint: Only memories below this strength can be forgotten, so important ones are protected.

forget_keep_poignancy.hint: Anything at or above this emotional intensity is never forgotten.

forget_batch_per_tick.hint: Maximum memories processed per lifecycle round.

auto_import_external.hint: Detect and convert not-yet-imported livingmemory memories automatically.

output_split_messages.hint: Send long replies as several messages, cut at semantic boundaries. Short sentences are never split.

output_typing_delay.hint: Delay follow-up messages by simulated typing time (the first one is sent immediately).

output_typing_max.hint: Cap on the typing delay, in seconds.

sticker_slot.hint: Local folder path. When a reply contains the [表情] marker a random sticker is sent. off disables it.

voice_slot.hint: A TTS provider id, or session to follow the conversation. off disables it.

favour_daily_cap.hint: Positive change stops accumulating at this value for the day (0 = unlimited).

favour_daily_half_life_days.hint: Half-life applied to the daily score (0 = decay off).

favour_tag_required.hint: On: only settle when the model emits a favour tag. Off: settle +1 even without one.

expression_min_uses.hint: A habit must have been used N times before it counts as verified.

expression_auto_min_corpus.hint: Learn expressions automatically once N unlearned corpus lines pile up; 0 = manual only.

memory_summary_prompt.hint: Custom prompt for memory summarisation (empty = built-in; supports the {transcript} placeholder).

recall_withdraw_reply.hint: On recall, also drop the local traces of the bot's replies (corpus and pending summary turns).

recall_handling.description: What to do with recalled memories
recall_handling.hint: log_only: record only. weaken: downweight (mark stale). delete: archive, still recoverable. Nothing is physically deleted.

track_platforms.hint: Platform instance ids allowed to be recorded (empty = auto-detect OneBot/QQ only). This plugin only serves QQ.

person_exclude_platforms.hint: webchat/webui are always blocked. Sessions from these platforms never enter memory, people or lists.

sys_prompt_memory_summary.hint: System prompt for the memory-summary task (empty = built-in default; editable under Settings -> Model assignment).

sys_prompt_expression_extract.hint: System prompt for the expression-extraction task (empty = built-in default; editable under Settings -> Model assignment).

sys_prompt_person_profile.hint: System prompt for the person-profile task (empty = built-in default; editable under Settings -> Model assignment -> Profiles).

sys_prompt_group_profile.hint: System prompt for the group-profile task (empty = built-in default; same card under Settings -> Model assignment -> Profiles).

sys_prompt_persona_evolve.hint: System prompt for the persona-evolution task (empty = built-in default; editable under Settings -> Model assignment).

sys_prompt_forget.hint: System prompt for the memory-forgetting evaluation (empty = built-in default; editable under Settings -> Model assignment).

evolve_pending_ttl_hours.hint: Pending proposals are dropped after this long, so one missed click never blocks evolution forever.

model_persona_evolve.hint: Which model drafts evolution proposals (empty = follow the conversation's current model; a cheap model is suggested).

gate_window_seconds.description: Gate scoring window (seconds): messages inside this window are scored together

gate_backoff_base.description: Minimum silent interval after being blocked (seconds)

gate_backoff_max.description: Maximum silent interval after being blocked (seconds)

session_context_enabled.description: Session context: pass the session's recent messages to the model

memory_capture_enabled.description: Memory capture: distill conversations into long-term memories (off = no new memories)

memory_capture_turns.description: Memory capture: summarize once every N conversation turns

memory_capture_min_interval.description: Memory capture: minimum interval between two summaries (seconds)

memory_capture_max_per_run.description: Memory capture: max memories written per run

memory_decay_half_life_days.description: Memory strength half-life (days): the longer a memory goes unmentioned, the weaker it gets

memory_evict_below.description: Memories below this strength are evicted first

memory_inject_budget_tokens.description: Per-turn memory injection budget (characters; rough cap to protect the context, about 1/4 in tokens)

person_exclude_ids.description: IDs to exclude from profiles / lists (the bot detects its own; this is a manual fallback)

model_memory_summary.description: Model for memory summarization (turning chats into long-term memories)
model_memory_summary.hint: Offline plugin task, never part of the chat reply. Empty = follow the session's current model.

model_expression_extract.description: Model for expression-habit extraction (learning how others talk)
model_expression_extract.hint: Offline plugin task, never part of the chat reply. Empty = follow the session's current model.

model_person_profile.description: Model for person / group profiles (both levels share this slot)
model_person_profile.hint: Offline plugin task, never part of the chat reply. Empty = follow the session's current model.

model_forget.description: Model for the forgetting review (deciding what to forget)
model_forget.hint: Offline plugin task, never part of the chat reply. Empty = follow the session's current model.

model_embedding.description: Embedding model (empty = use the embedding provider configured in AstrBot)
model_embedding.hint: When empty, the embedding provider configured in AstrBot is used.

model_rerank.description: Rerank model (empty = use the rerank provider configured in AstrBot)
model_rerank.hint: When empty, the rerank provider configured in AstrBot is used.

proactive_enabled.description: Proactive: start a topic yourself when nobody has talked for a while

proactive_shadow.description: Proactive shadow mode: record candidates without sending (run it for a few days first)

proactive_idle_min.description: Minutes of silence before considering speaking up

proactive_min_interval_min.description: Minimum interval between two proactive messages (minutes)

proactive_min_zone.description: Minimum relationship zone required to speak up (NEUTRAL/FAMILIAR/CLOSE)

proactive_last_only.description: Only send to the last person who talked

proactive_use_persona.description: Include the AstrBot persona and context when speaking up (off = bare message, not recommended)

proactive_style.description: Style prompt for opening lines (short, no follow-up questions works best)

proactive_context_memories.description: How many memories to inject before speaking up

proactive_auto_wl.description: Automatically add people you have talked to into the proactive list (off = fill it by hand)

proactive_mode_private.description: Private list mode: white / black / off

proactive_mode_group.description: Group list mode: white = whitelist only, black = exclude blacklist, off = never

recall_weaken_factor.description: Memory strength multiplier when a recall matches (0-1; smaller = harsher)

recall_keep_days.description: How many days recalled messages are kept (visible on the Recall page)

recall_interrupt_reply.description: Interrupt the reply still being generated when a message is recalled (its content is void anyway)

recall_react_enabled.description: Recall reaction: when someone recalls a message, the model decides on the spot what to say (ignore / ask / tease)
recall_react_enabled.hint: Uses AstrBot's full prompt; ignores the proactive list and quiet hours; the user just sees a normal message.

recall_react_group.description: Recall reaction - group scope: related = only messages that involved the bot, all = anyone, off = never in groups

recall_react_images.description: Recall reaction: also show the recalled image to the model (native multimodal, up to 2)

recall_react_extra.description: Recall reaction: extra instruction appended to the recall notice (empty = none)

dashboard.title: StarHeart - Control Panel
dashboard.description: Memory graph / memory library / profiles / expression learning / message events / personas / settings
